items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-13
items.q: And Charlie Hamilton's also a good pianist.

ctx.x: No, no. It was Albert Burbank, Jack Willis, Frog Joseph. Jeanette Kimball played piano. She's good, too. And some fellow called Frank on bass. Frank's somebody or other on bass. Fields, Frank Fields. And Louis Barberin on drums. But who else is there? Well, I like Frank Moyet very much, the piano player. And Charlie Hamilton's also a good pianist. Who else is there? I liked what little he did of Earl Humphrey over the river. Last Saturday he played with the Thomas band over the river at this dance. And he has a…
And what is that dance like over the river?
